title: Zesty Roasted Argentinian Galangal Skewers
description: A romantic and flavorful Argentinian dish featuring galangal, perfect for a special occasion. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe combines the brightness of citrus with the depth of tadka spices.

ingredients.name: galangal
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, tadka spice blend, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced galangal, red bell pepper, and onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated galangal, red bell pepper, and onion onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the skewers from the oven and brush with additional olive oil if necessary.
Return the skewers to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and top each with a slice of hard boiled egg.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional tadka spice blend if desired.
